https://www.nngroup.com/articles/wayfinding/

A quick reminder that a map is also an invitation: people need to know where
to begin, what choices they have, and how to leave without feeling lost.

Pull one useful idea into [Design principles](/note/notes/design_principles) before
the next prototype pass. No need to preserve the whole article if the note only
turns into a single sentence.
